tagline: Spec-Kit plus worktrees and kanban orchestration.

phases.label: Constitution
phases.note: Encode team standards once; enforce automatically.

phases.label: Specify
phases.note: Creates the feature branch and a dedicated git worktree.

phases.label: Implement
phases.note: Build the feature in worktree isolation.

phases.label: Review
phases.note: Peer review + validation against quality gates.

phases.label: Merge
phases.note: Merge to main with worktree cleanup.

scenarios.note: Spec-Kit's issues **plus worktree overhead** — excessive for a one-line change.
Spec-Kit workflow + worktree isolation. Good for larger features.
Worktree isolation helps, but workflow overhead for a medium change.
Worktree + spec workflow **too slow for emergencies**.
Built-in **worktree strategy** + kanban dashboard. Designed for exactly this.
Worktree isolation doesn't help cross-spec changes.

keyFeatures: Live kanban dashboard (Planned → Doing → Review → Done)
Git worktree strategy for parallel feature isolation
Coordinates up to 11 AI coding agents simultaneously
13 built-in commands + mission system (Software Dev / Deep Research)
limitations: Adds complexity on top of Spec-Kit — must learn both
Dashboard overhead unnecessary for solo / simple projects
Community-maintained — not officially supported by GitHub
